narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>For the last one, I take away the tops and the bottoms. I get one whole.
<bookmark mark='long'/>One whole is more than two thirds, the length Tanvi started with.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Taking away can never leave more than you began with.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, add back what you took away.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>One sixth and three sixths make four sixths, which is two thirds.
<bookmark mark='sum2'/>Seven eighteenths and eight eighteenths make fifteen eighteenths, which is five sixths.
